scenes.name: MYTH OR MAP
lines: Grand unification is often told as a victory: one page of equations, and the universe is closed.
大统一常被写成一部凯旋史：一页方程，宇宙就此闭合。
This book draws a map instead: how far one small discrete structure walks on its own, and where it stops.
本书改画一张地图：一枚小小的离散结构凭自己能走多远，又在哪里停步。

scenes.name: FOUR QUESTIONS
lines: The exam has one rule: one master connection, and nothing fitted after the fact.
这份考卷只有一条规矩：同一条主联络，不做任何事后拟合。
Question one: make the three forces meet, and fix the Higgs mass and the electroweak scale.
第一问：让三种力交汇，并锁定希格斯质量与电弱尺度。
Question two: exactly three generations of chiral fermions on a four-dimensional lattice.
第二问：在四维格点上恰好得到三代手征费米子。
Question three: the flavour hierarchy, quark mixing, and a proton that stays alive.
第三问：味谱层级、夸克混合，以及一颗活下来的质子。
Question four: a spin-two graviton, and a cosmological constant near ten to the minus one hundred twenty-two.
第四问：自旋二的引力子，以及约为十的负一百二十二次方的宇宙学常数。

scenes.name: THE SCORE
lines: Each question already has a model-internal witness, recomputable inside chosen inputs: four out of four.
每一问都已有模型内见证，可在选定输入下独立复算：四问四有。
But derived outright from one connection, with zero fits? Zero out of four.
可若要求从同一主联络、零拟合地完整推出？四问零成。
The honest score is both numbers, side by side.
诚实的总账，是把这两个数并排写出。

scenes.name: SIX TIERS
lines: To keep both numbers honest, every claim wears exactly one of six tags.
为让这两个数都诚实，每条断言只佩戴六种标签中的一种。
Green LEAN: a theorem frozen and checked by the Lean kernel at the pinned commit.
绿色 LEAN：在所钉提交上冻结、经 Lean 内核检验的定理。
EXT-LEAN: the Riemann hypothesis and Dirichlet GRH, proved in Lean elsewhere, and never shown green.
EXT-LEAN：经典黎曼猜想与狄利克雷 GRH，已在别处由 Lean 证明，但从不显示为绿色。
Violet ARGUED for written proofs, cyan NUM for exact certificates, violet MODEL for chosen constructions.
紫色 ARGUED 给书面证明，青色 NUM 给精确证书，紫色 MODEL 给选定的构造。
Red OPEN for what nobody has derived. No claim may borrow its neighbour's badge.
红色 OPEN 留给尚无人导出的结论。任何断言都不许借邻居的徽章。

scenes.name: A SHARP NO
lines: Why a whole book about a zero? Because every no here is exact.
为什么为一个零写一整本书？因为这里的每一个“不行”都是精确的。
By certificate, every decreasing winding weight leaves a rival vacuum more than one quarter below the flavour vacuum.
区间证书：任意单调递减绕数权下，总有竞争真空比味真空低出逾四分之一。
And the shell's Laplacian needs exactly twenty-one rational coordinates, not eighteen.
球壳的拉普拉斯恰需二十一个有理坐标，而不是十八个。
A sharp no is closer to a law of nature than a blurry close enough.
清晰的“不行”比含混的“差不多”更接近自然律。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Five volumes follow, each setting constructions and obstructions side by side.
接下来的五卷，每一卷都把正向构造与刚性障碍并排陈列。
But first: what is the one small object every question will be put to?
但先问一句：四个问题要交给的那个小对象是什么？

scenes.name: THE SHELL

chapter.en: Volume I · The shell, two clocks and the zeros
chapter.zh: 第一卷 · 贝伦德球壳、双时钟与零点

lines: The answer: nineteen whole-number points on one sphere.
答案小到可以托在手心：同一个球面上的十九个整数点。
Each has x squared plus y squared plus z squared equal to eight hundred sixty-seven, three times seventeen squared.
每个点都满足 x² + y² + z² = 867，也就是 3 × 17²。
Cycling the coordinates fixes one pole and turns six orbits of three.
轮换坐标时，一个极点不动，其余十八点排成六条三点轨道。
Picking this shell is a model choice; after it, everything is hard arithmetic.
选中这颗球壳是模型选择；一旦选定，其余一切都是硬算术。

scenes.name: 135 EDGES
lines: Join two points whenever their squared distance is at most eight hundred four.
两点的平方距离不超过 804 时，就连一条边。
Of one hundred seventy-one pairs, one hundred thirty-five survive, closing five hundred twenty-nine triangles.
171 个点对里留下 135 条边，围出 529 个三角面。
They come in just twenty-three squared lengths.
这些边只有 23 种平方弦长。

scenes.name: 22 FREQUENCIES
lines: Each length becomes an arc angle, the arc cosine of one minus j over seventeen thirty-four.
每种弦长变成一个弧角：θⱼ = arccos(1 − j/1734)。
Are these twenty-three angles rationally independent? Exactly one relation survives.
这 23 个角在有理数上线性无关吗？恰好只剩一条关系。
Three points lie in order on one great circle, so theta one thirty-six is theta twelve plus theta sixty-eight.
三个点依次落在同一个大圆上，于是 θ₁₃₆ = θ₁₂ + θ₆₈。
Galois characters rule out every other relation: twenty-two independent frequencies remain.
伽罗瓦特征标排除了其余一切关系：剩下二十二个独立频率。

scenes.name: RANK 18 · DIM 21
lines: The shell's Laplacian has real rank eighteen: real square roots embed it in eighteen dimensions.
这张图的拉普拉斯矩阵实数秩为 18：借实数开方就能嵌进 18 维。
With rational coordinates, a two-adic Hasse symbol vetoes eighteen, nineteen and twenty. The minimum is twenty-one.
只许有理坐标时，2-进哈塞符号否决了 18、19、20 维：最小是 21 维。

scenes.name: TWO CLOCKS
lines: Now let the shell keep time. Two ordinary phases always commute.
现在让球壳计时。两个普通复相位总是交换：先后无关。
So promote the clock edges, seven twenty-four and eight oh four, to unit quaternions U and V.
于是把 724 与 804 两类时钟边，提升为单位四元数 U 与 V。
Their failure to commute is one number, the defect E: the squared area between their axes.
它们不交换的程度只是一个数：亏量 E，即两根转轴所张面积的平方。
E is a Gram determinant, and for nonzero integer quaternions Lean checks it is never negative.
E 是一个三阶格拉姆行列式；对非零整四元数，Lean 检验它永不为负。

scenes.name: HAAR FROM ZEROS
lines: Feed the clocks the heights gamma of the Riemann zeros, and read four angles at each.
把黎曼零点的高度 γ 喂给时钟，在每个零点上读出四个弧角。
Keep a zero when the fourth angle falls below sine squared p, times sine squared q, times sine v.
第四个角落在 sin²p · sin²q · |sin v| 之下时，就保留这个零点。
Of the first fifty zeros, six pass: eight, fifteen, twenty-eight, thirty-one, thirty-eight and fifty.
前五十个零点里通过了六个：第 8、15、28、31、38、50 个。
Given RH, the kept zeros have density one over two pi, the largest possible, and average to Haar integrals.
在 RH 之下，被保留的零点密度为 1/(2π)，已是最大，平均出哈尔积分。
Lean checks Schur orthogonality, the tool behind those group integrals.
这些群积分背后的工具是舒尔正交关系，已由 Lean 检验。
But a sampler is not dynamics: real couplings at one TeV miss the unified ratios by far.
可采样器不是动力学：1 TeV 处真实耦合的比值离统一值很远。

scenes.name: EXTERNAL FACT
lines: RH itself is an external fact: Levent Alpöge's Lean proof of RH, certified in November twenty twenty-six.
RH 本身是外部事实：Levent Alpöge 的 Lean 证明，2026 年 11 月获认证。
It is not frozen in this book's library, so it stays violet, never green, and says nothing about physics.
它尚未冻结进本书的库，所以标紫色而非绿色，也不对物理说任何话。
Inside the library, Lean checks the Cayley picture: the critical line rolls onto the unit circle.
库内，Lean 检验了凯莱图景：临界线被卷到单位圆上。
So RH is exactly the statement that no nontrivial zero leaves the circle.
于是 RH 恰好等价于：没有一个非平凡零点离开这个圆。

scenes.name: ZERO WINDOWS
lines: In a finite window, zero 11431 sits almost exactly midway between two neighbours.
在有限零点窗里，第 11431 个零点几乎恰好落在两个邻居的中点。
Among three thousand centres it wins by thirty-five times, yet far higher up such centres have density one.
在三千个中心里，它比次优者锐利 35 倍有余；但再往高处，这样的中心密度为 1。
Zeros 8236 and 8359 are the first to pass three physics windows, given a chosen field table and cut.
第 8236 与 8359 个零点首先通过三道物理窗口，前提是选定的场表与分界。
No theorem yet bridges global averages to the clock reading of one zero. That gap is open.
还没有定理把全局平均接到单个零点的时钟读数上：这道缺口仍是开放的。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Volume One built the instrument: one shell, two clocks, and the zeros that drive them.
第一卷造好了仪器：一个球壳、两只时钟，以及驱动它们的零点。
Now the first question of unification.
现在轮到大统一的第一问。

scenes.name: THREE LINES

chapter.en: Volume II · Question 1: couplings, traces and the Higgs portal
chapter.zh: 第二卷 · 第一问：耦合交汇、动能谱迹与希格斯门户

lines: Volume one asked: can this one shell make the three forces meet?
第一卷问道：这一个球壳，能让三种力交汇吗？
Run the measured couplings up from the Z mass with Standard Model slopes, and the three lines miss.
从 Z 质量处的实测耦合出发，按标准模型的斜率往高能跑，三条直线彼此错身而过。

scenes.name: THE GAP
lines: One combination sees only the miss: alpha one inverse, minus three alpha two, plus two alpha three.
有一个组合只看得见错位：α₁ 的逆，减三倍 α₂ 的逆，加两倍 α₃ 的逆。
It is blind to a common coupling, to complete families, and to heavy gauge vectors.
它看不见共同耦合、完整家族与重规范矢量。
On the light fields it reads minus two fifths, so it climbs only one over five pi per e-fold.
对轻场它读出负五分之二，所以每个 e 倍只爬升五π分之一。
Where alpha one meets alpha three, alpha two misses by three point six six four units.
在 α₁ 与 α₃ 相交处，α₂ 差了 3.664 个单位。

scenes.name: MONOTONE WALL
lines: Can the shell's own heavy tower close it, with one shared, nondecreasing mass rule?
球壳自己的重塔，能用一条共用的非减质量规则填平它吗？
Interval certificates say no on the whole dual-clock torus: the spread stays above zero point seven zero four eight.
区间证书在整个双时钟环面上说不：极差始终大于 0.7048。
Keep only the native generators, or pin the unit to the Planck mass, and the wall grows taller.
只留原生生成元，或把单位钉在普朗克质量，墙只会更高。
Underneath lies a kernel-checked identity: the Cauchy-Schwarz defect is a sum of squares.
墙下垫着一条内核验证的恒等式：柯西—施瓦茨亏量是平方和。

scenes.name: TWO KEYS
lines: Two keys open the door: different mass multipliers for weak doublets and singlets, or each step a positive contraction.
两把钥匙能开门：给弱双重态与单态不同的质量倍率，或把每一步归一成正收缩。
At two loops the first retrodicts alpha s near zero point one one eight four, the second zero point one one eight nine.
两圈下，第一把反推 α_s 约为 0.1184，第二把给出 0.1189。
Keep the masses, switch the matching scheme, and the answer jumps to zero point one five three.
质量不变、只换匹配处方，答案就跳到 0.153。
And the denominator, multiplier and scalar count were chosen after seeing the fit: conditional, not derived.
而且分母、倍率与标量数都是看过拟合后才选的：这是条件构造，不是推导。

scenes.name: TRACE AND CEILING
lines: Next, let one positive spectral trace generate the couplings, not a boundary set by hand.
接着，让同一条正谱迹生成耦合，而不是手设一条边界。
Pair each layer as a scalar, a Dirac field and three right partners: the trace reads six, six, six.
每层配一份标量、一份狄拉克场与三份右伙伴：谱迹读出六、六、六。
Running weighs spin differently: two thirds of a left doublet survive and close the gap near five times ten to the fourteen GeV.
跑动按自旋计权：三分之二份左双重态留下来，在约 5×10¹⁴ GeV 处填平缺口。
Above that crossing, perturbation ends by fourteen Q for the product group, and by thirty Q even inside Spin ten.
交点之上，积群的微扰到 14Q 就终结，即便并入 Spin(10) 也只到 30Q。

scenes.name: RANK FIVE
lines: The heavy fields also pull on the Higgs: every two-loop threshold is positive, about ten to the twenty-six GeV squared.
重场也在拉扯希格斯：每一项两圈阈值都为正，合计约 10²⁶ GeV²。
A traceless neutral portal could cancel it, but unitarity caps contact amplitudes at eight pi.
无迹中性门户可以抵消它，但幺正性把接触振幅封顶在 8π。
At rank four or less, the contact bound already exceeds thirty-one point nine.
秩不超过四时，接触下界就已超过 31.9。
Rank five fits: one positive and four equal negative directions, its margin certified by a kernel-checked Schur minimum.
秩五放得下：一个正方向配四个等量负方向，裕度由内核验证的舒尔极小值认证。

scenes.name: LOW-ENERGY PINCH
lines: The broken vacuum's light partners land exactly where colliders already look.
破缺真空的轻伙伴，恰好落在对撞机早已在看的地方。
Gluon fusion to the Higgs rises above five and a half times the Standard Model; charged partners widen the Z and lose to CLEO.
胶子融合产生希格斯超过标准模型的五倍半；带电伙伴加宽 Z，并输给 CLEO 数据。
The minimal equal-depth vacuum fixes the Higgs cubic coupling at exactly three times its Standard Model value.
最小等深真空把希格斯三次自耦合精确锁在标准模型值的三倍。

scenes.name: QUESTION ONE OPEN
lines: So Question one is not yet answered from first principles.
所以第一问尚未从第一性原理解出。
Still open: matching from the partition function, physics above the ceiling, and a weak scale without fine-tuning.
仍然开放的是：从配分函数导出匹配、封顶之上的物理，以及无需精细调节的电弱标度。
Next question: can the same shell make three generations of matter, and keep the proton alive?
下一问：同一个球壳，能造出三代物质并让质子活下来吗？

scenes.name: FIVE CHARGES

chapter.en: Volume III · Questions 2 and 3: generations, flavour and the proton
chapter.zh: 第三卷 · 第二与第三问：手征三代、味谱与质子

lines: Can the same shell make three generations, and keep the proton alive? Volume three asks both.
同一个球壳，能造出三代物质并让质子活下来吗？第三卷同时追问这两件事。
Five hypercharges each put their own magnetic Laplacian on the nineteen points.
五种超荷各自在十九个点上装出一个磁拉普拉斯算子。

scenes.name: THREE LIGHT MODES
lines: A certificate finds three light modes below 8.685 in every spectrum, and sixteen heavy ones above 9.6.
区间证书在每条谱里都找到三个低于 8.685 的轻模，其余十六个重模都高于 9.6。
For every clock phase and every positive zero, one per cyclic character.
对任意时钟相位与全部正零点都成立，三个循环特征标各占一模。
The model cuts at the smallest site variance, held by three outer sites: just under ten.
模型在最小站点方差处分界；它由三个外点取到，略低于十。

scenes.name: WHY THREE?
lines: Careful: over all zeros, the gaps allow one, three, seven or fifteen modes.
但要小心：在全部零点上，谱隙容许的轻模数是一、三、七或十五。
Equal character shares still leave three and fifteen. Nothing yet pins three.
要求特征标等重，仍同时留下三与十五。还没有什么把三钉死。

scenes.name: FOUR DIMENSIONS
lines: Three eigenvalues are not yet chiral fermions. They need a four-dimensional lattice.
三个本征值还不是手征费米子，它们需要一张四维格点。
A Wilson mass in a narrow window leaves exactly three species of one handedness.
威尔逊质量落在一个窄窗内时，恰好留下三个同手征的物种。
On smooth flux, the index is minus three times a Pfaffian: three copies.
在光滑磁通上，指数等于负三倍普法夫值：正好三份。

scenes.name: ROUGH BACKGROUND
lines: But the path integral is rough: fields that smooth have probability below two to the minus 560.
可路径积分是粗糙的：那样光滑的场，概率低于二的负 560 次方。
On a rough SU(5) background the centre charge is two, mod five. It does not cancel.
在一个粗糙 SU(5) 背景上，中心荷模五余二，没有抵消。
Three Higgs frames leave SU(2) and near-zero modes; four frames hold the gap.
三份希格斯标架留下 SU(2) 与近零模；四份标架才守住谱隙。

scenes.name: BREAK THE CYCLE
lines: Question three: mixing. If both Yukawa matrices keep the exact cycle, mixing is only a permutation.
第三问：混合。若两套汤川矩阵都保持精确轮换，混合只能是置换。
Nature mixes. With V_cb above 0.035 and V_tb above 0.98, a few lines of algebra give a floor:
自然界有混合。取 |V_cb| > 0.035、|V_tb| > 0.98，几行代数给出一个下界：
some Yukawa matrix misses the cycle by more than 0.0414.
至少有一套汤川矩阵偏离轮换超过 0.0414（对易子范数）。

scenes.name: YUKAWA WALLS
lines: Then the natural mechanisms hit certified walls.
接着，那些最自然的机制逐一撞上有证书的墙。
One light Higgs keeps charm over top above 0.0272. Nature has 0.00361.
单支轻希格斯让粲顶比始终高于 0.0272，自然界是 0.00361。
Site-density potentials keep top over bottom below thirty on all 1238 zeros; nature needs over forty.
只看站点密度的势能，在全部 1238 枚零点上都把顶底比压在三十以下；自然界需要四十以上。
Seven orbit weights stop quarks over leptons at 3.34, not 84.98. Sharp walls, not bad fits.
七轨道非负权把上型夸克/轻子比挡在 3.34，目标是 84.98：是墙，不是拟合差。

scenes.name: CAYLEY FOLDING
lines: To fold flavour without drift, use a Cayley rotation made of fractions.
要把味矩阵折叠而不带漂移，就用凯莱旋转：矩阵里全是分数。
Lean checks that R transpose R is the identity for every rational vector, and that equal Gram matrices differ by a unitary.
Lean 内核检验：对每个有理向量，R 的转置乘 R 都是单位阵；格拉姆矩阵相同的两个矩阵只差一个幺正矩阵。
A fixed rational response then matches ideal mixing to ten to the minus eleven on seven zeros.
随后，一个固定的有理响应在七枚零点上把理想混合逼近到十的负十一次方以内。
But it was calibrated on one zero. A reconstruction, not a derivation.
但它是在一枚零点上对照实测混合校准的。这是重构，不是推导。

scenes.name: BARYON TRIALITY
lines: Now the proton. The dimension-six operator QQQL lets it decay.
现在轮到质子。六维算符 QQQL 让它可以衰变。
Gauge orthogonality cannot kill it: it has thirty-six nonzero terms.
规范正交管不住它：单代展开有三十六个非零单项。
Baryon triality can: its charge is minus h times baryon number, mod three.
重子三重对称管得住：它的荷是负 h 乘重子数，模三。
QQQL is forbidden, the Yukawas stay, and the first allowed violation jumps to dimension fifteen.
QQQL 被禁止，汤川项全部保留，最低的容许破坏算符跳到十五维。

scenes.name: NO ANOMALY
lines: It even has a gauge origin: X equals three B minus nine L_tau.
它甚至有规范来源：X = 3B − 9L_τ。
All six anomaly traces cancel exactly.
六项反常迹逐一精确归零。

scenes.name: THE FORK
lines: Yet the shell does not decide. One joint witness zero, the same vacuum, two completions.
可球壳本身并不拍板：一枚联合见证零点，同一真空，两种紫外扩张。
Orthogonal currents keep the proton; parallel currents switch QQQL on, at least 0.03144.
正交辅助电流保住质子；平行电流激活 QQQL，威尔逊因子至少约 0.03144。
Whether the proton lives, and why exactly three, remain open.
质子是否永生、为何恰是三代，仍然开放。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Volume three: sharp walls, working reconstructions, honest gaps.
第三卷：清晰的墙、能用的重构、诚实的缺口；是模型内的见证，不是推导。
And gravity: can deficit angles give a graviton and a tiny cosmological constant?
引力呢：单纯形上的角亏能给出引力子与极小的宇宙学常数吗？

scenes.name: QUESTION FOUR

chapter.en: Volume IV · Question 4: Regge gravity and dark energy
chapter.zh: 第四卷 · 第四问：雷吉引力与暗能量

lines: Question four is gravity: can bent geometry alone give a graviton, Newton's constant and a tiny dark energy?
第四问是引力：单凭弯曲的几何，能否给出引力子、牛顿常数与极小的暗能量？
Build spacetime from rigid four-simplices, flat inside, with all curvature on the triangles they share.
用刚性的四维单纯形拼出时空：每块内部平直，曲率全部集中在它们共享的三角面上。

scenes.name: DEFICIT ANGLES
lines: Around each triangle, a hinge, simplices meet at one fixed angle, arc cosine of one quarter.
绕每张三角面（铰链），四单纯形以同一个二面角 arccos(1/4) 相接。
Four leave a gap of about fifty-eight degrees; five overlap by eighteen. That gap is the deficit angle.
四块留下约 58° 的缺口，五块则重叠约 18°。这个缺口就是角亏。
Summed with areas, deficits give the Regge action, and two Pachner moves read Newton's constant back out.
角亏乘面积求和即雷吉作用；两次帕赫纳移动就能从中反演出牛顿常数。
Beneath it, a coboundary applied twice is zero, and Lean checks this with no axioms.
其底层，上边缘算子作用两次恒为零；Lean 在零公理下检验了这一点。

scenes.name: SPIN TWO
lines: On a flat lattice with metric g equals I minus J over five, every deficit is zero.
在度量 g = I − J/5 的平直格上，所有角亏都为零。
Wiggle it, and a certificate gives the long-wave propagator, twenty over k squared.
扰动它，证书给出长波传播子 20/k²。
Turn the frame by theta and its two residues turn by two theta: helicity plus and minus two.
把参考系转过 θ，两个留数分量就转过 2θ：螺旋度 ±2。
The price: at every nonzero momentum, one conformal direction has the opposite sign.
代价是：在每个非零动量上，都有一个共形方向符号相反。

scenes.name: FINITE LOADS
lines: Now let each hinge carry a finite count instead of an area.
现在让每张铰链承载有限的计数，而不是面积。
Flatness needs one load to be root three times another, and no rational loads can do that.
平直驻点要求一类负载恰为另一类的 √3 倍，任何有理负载都做不到。
Born amplitudes need a field of degree four; a right-angle spinor needed only root two.
玻恩振幅至少需要四次数域；而直角旋量只需 √2。
The best integer state misses flatness by exactly one, so the geometry curves, negatively.
最佳整数态与平直恰差 1，于是几何发生弯曲，且曲率为负。

scenes.name: INDUCED GRAVITY
lines: Perhaps the constants are induced instead, by quantum fluctuations of all matter, as Sakharov proposed.
也许这些常数是诱导出来的：来自全部物质的量子涨落，这是萨哈罗夫的设想。
Visible matter alone keeps Lambda G above one point one eight percent, at least a hundred nineteen orders too big.
仅凭可见重谱，ΛG 始终大于 0.0118，比目标高出至少 119 个数量级。
Three hundred eleven extra singlets can hit the target, but only by tuning a hundred and twenty-two digits.
加入 311 份实单态可以命中目标，但须精调 122 位数字。
Then a cutoff shift of four parts in ten to the hundred and twenty flips its sign.
此时截止只要上调约 4.22×10⁻¹²⁰，它就翻为负值。

scenes.name: FOUR LAYERS
lines: A sturdier idea: weights minus one, three, minus three, one, on four equally spaced squared masses.
更稳的思路：在四个等距平方质量上放权重 −1、3、−3、1。
They cancel three moments, so every divergence cancels and a finite positive term survives.
它们消去三阶以下的矩，发散全部相消，只留下有限且为正的一项。
In this model, with a chosen mass rule, one real zero lands at point nine nine nine four of the target.
在本模型中，取选定的质量规则，一枚真实零点给出目标值的 0.9994 倍。
But the broken Higgs vacuum adds a tree term fifty-five orders larger, with the wrong sign.
但电弱破缺的希格斯真空带来一项树级贡献，大出 55 个数量级，而且符号相反。

scenes.name: SCORE FOR Q4
lines: Score for question four: exact algebra checked by Lean, and sharp certificates inside chosen models.
第四问的成绩：Lean 检验的精确代数，加上选定模型内的一批尖锐证书。
Deriving gravity, Newton's constant and the dark energy without hand-put inputs is still open.
不靠手工输入，导出引力、牛顿常数与暗能量，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: NEXT QUESTION
lines: Each question has picked its own favourite zeros.
每一问都挑中了各自偏爱的零点。
Can all four questions be answered by one clock at once?
四个问题能被同一只钟同时回答吗？

scenes.name: ONE CLOCK

chapter.en: Volume V · One clock for four questions
chapter.zh: 第五卷 · 四问共用一只钟

lines: To find out, stop tuning four separate clocks and force all four sectors onto one.
要回答这一问，就不能再给四个部门各配一只钟，而要把它们强行压到同一只钟上。
The clock is one filter, sampled at j equals one, two, three, and onward.
这只钟是同一个滤波器，在 j 等于一、二、三……的刻度上依次采样。
Its weights may only sit on zeros that pass three windows at once; the first is zero number 8359.
它的权重只能落在同时通过三窗的零点上；第一枚这样的零点是第 8359 号。

scenes.name: FIFTH TIME
lines: With one shared probability, the first four readings close exactly.
共用同一组概率时，前四项读数可以精确闭合。
The fifth cannot: every allowed setting prints a 22-bit code one step below the reference.
第五项不行：一切合法配置吐出的 22 位二进制码，都比参考码低一格。
Let the flavour side reweight the zeros, and the efficiency ratio must exceed 18.4968.
若允许味侧给零点重新加权，效率倍率必须超过 18.4968。
The neutral shell just clears it: its resolvent trace climbs from one to nineteen.
中性球壳恰好越过这道门槛：它的预解式迹从 1 一路升到 19。
Five readings close, but the sixth is pushed up by at least 1.33 times ten to the minus eight.
前五项闭合了，第六项却被迫上移至少 1.33 × 10⁻⁸。

scenes.name: SEVENTH TIME
lines: Now lock six readings, and ask how far the unseen seventh can move.
现在锁住六项读数，再问：从未看过的第七项还能晃动多少？
Two Gauss-Radau rules pin it inside a window about two trillionths wide.
两套高斯—拉道求积把它夹在一个宽约万亿分之二的窗口里。
Its 35-bit code is forced, and it lands 4130 codes away from the reference.
它的 35 位二进制码被强迫锁定，与参考码相差 4130 格。
Forty-four input bits make that prediction certain; with forty-three, two different codes appear.
输入保留 44 位时这条预言确定无疑；退到 43 位，就会出现两个不同的码。

scenes.name: THREE BANDS
lines: The same six readings squeeze over 99.93 percent of the weight into three narrow height bands.
同样这六项读数，把超过 99.93% 的权重挤进三条狭窄的高度带。
And on the eight-zero solution, the CP invariant J, never used in the fit, comes out 6.08 percent short.
而在八点解上，从未参与拟合的 CP 不变量 J 比参考值低了 6.08%。
Two Lean-checked inequalities sit behind the squeeze: Fourier mass caps band weight, and variance floors collisions.
挤压背后是两条经 Lean 检验的不等式：傅里叶质量封顶频带权重，方差托底碰撞。

scenes.name: WINDING LADDER
lines: So stop choosing weights from outside, and write an action on the shell's 529 triangles.
那就别再从外部挑权重，而在球壳的 529 个三角面上写下作用量。
Each triangle carries a twist, because quaternion turns do not commute; Lean checks that witness.
每个三角面都带一个扭转，因为四元数旋转不可交换；这一见证由 Lean 检验。
Climb the winding number: no stationary point up to 18, a saddle at 19, a valley at 21.
逐级抬高绕数：18 圈以内没有驻点，19 圈出现鞍点，21 圈出现局部极小。
At 27 the lowest state enters the windows but flavour collapses; only at 105 does one vacuum hold everything.
27 圈时全局最低点进入三窗，味却塌缩；直到 105 圈，才有一个真空同时守住一切。
Weights that never grow with winding lose by more than a quarter, and 100 free coefficients remain.
随绕数不增的权重总要输掉四分之一以上；而且仍留下 100 个自由系数。

scenes.name: ONE ZERO
lines: On one real zero, some two point three trillion up the line, it all happens at once.
在一枚真实零点上——编号约两万三千亿——这一切同时发生。
Three windows pass, the energy sits just above the vacuum, and both flavour readings land within 1.4 parts per million.
三窗全过，能量仅比真空高一点点，两项味读数都落在百万分之 1.4 以内。
Four stress tests then crack it: near the vacuum, distinct weights become invisible, and light spaces leak.
随后四重压力测试撬开裂隙：近真空处不同权重无法分辨，轻子空间互相泄漏。
The same vacuum allows proton-safe and proton-decaying currents, and fixes only the ratio k over d squared.
同一真空既容得下保护质子的电流，也容得下让它衰变的电流，而且只钉死比值 k/d²。

scenes.name: 624 CHANNELS
lines: Look inside the shell: twelve states with four readings, twelve with six, compared twice, give 624 channels.
往壳内看：十二个态各四种读数，十二个态各六种，各比两次，共 624 条通道。
An independent threshold inversion puts the gain between 623.91 and 624.09.
一次独立的阈值反演，把增益夹在 623.91 与 624.09 之间。
But copying three clock responses costs hidden memory: thirty-eight states with the old block fixed, nineteen at best.
但要复现三个时钟响应，就得付出隐藏记忆：固定旧块需 38 个态，最少也要 19 个。
A Lean-checked Schur theorem shows the reason: with too little hidden room, outer responses cannot vanish at will.
一条经 Lean 检验的舒尔定理说明了原因：隐藏空间不够时，外部响应不能随意清零。
And five selection rules crown five different zeros.
而五条选点准则，把桂冠戴到五枚不同的零点头上。

scenes.name: BALANCE SHEET
lines: The balance sheet: four questions, four model-internal witnesses, every one reproducible.
总账：四个问题，四个模型内见证，每一个都可以复算。
Derived from one action with nothing fitted: zero of four.
从同一个作用量出发、不做任何拟合推出的：四个中零个。
Five tensions and four open problems now mark exactly what is missing.
五重张力与四个开放问题，如今精确标出了还缺什么。

scenes.name: NEXT
lines: Four witnesses, zero derivations.
四个见证，零个推导。
Why is that worth a book?
这为什么值得一本书？

scenes.name: THE SCORE

chapter.en: Coda · Why a sharp no matters
chapter.zh: 终章 · 为什么清晰的否定有力量

lines: Four witnesses, zero derivations. Why is that worth a book?
四个见证、零个推导。这为什么值得一本书？
Every question has a working, recomputable construction inside the model.
每一问都在模型内有可行、可复算的构造。
None is yet derived from one master connection without fitting.
但没有一问已经从同一条主联络出发、无拟合地推出。

scenes.name: SIX WALLS
lines: Because a sharp no draws a map. Six walls now stand on it.
因为清晰的否定能画出地图。如今地图上立着六道墙。
One positive trace cannot unify at scale ratio 189 or below; a neutral portal needs rank five.
单一正谱迹在尺度比 189 及以下无法交汇；中性门户至少要秩五。
Monotone winding weights lose by more than a quarter; one fixed vacuum needs a hundred and five windings.
单调绕数权以超过四分之一的能量差落败；同一组固定权重的真空要到 105 圈。
Hidden memory steps from thirty-eight states to nineteen; six clock readings force the seventh code.
辅助记忆秩从 38 一级级降到 19；六项时钟读数强制第七项的整数码。

scenes.name: FOUR GATES
lines: Any future master connection must pass four gates, with zero fitting.
未来任何主联络都必须零拟合地通过四道门禁。
Thresholds and the electroweak scale from within, with no ten-to-the-twenty-one tuning.
从内部给出重阈值与电弱标度，不靠 10²¹ 量级的微调。
Three generations, the CP phase and the baryon branch, chosen by dynamics.
三代、CP 相位与重子分支，都由动力学选出。
Newton's constant and dark energy, with no borrowed Planck scale.
牛顿常数与暗能量，不借外部的普朗克标尺。
And a physical rule for the weights, instead of a hundred free directions.
再加一条物理的选权原理，取代一百个自由方向。

scenes.name: TRILOGY
lines: This book is the last of three: Ortho Quantum charted the course and posed the questions.
本书是三部曲的最后一部：《量子计算的几何直觉》定下航向，提出了这些问题。
Omega Math forged the hull, rational mathematics with zero axioms.
《OMEGA 数学》铸成船身：零公理的有理数学。
Omega Unify took both into deep water, with a real chart.
《OMEGA 统一》带着两者驶入深水，手里有真实的海图。

scenes.name: RECEIPT
lines: The receipt: green only where the Lean kernel checked a frozen statement.
收据：绿色只给 Lean 内核检查过的冻结陈述。
Cyan for certificates, violet for models, red for what is still open.
青色是证书，紫色是模型，红色是仍然开放的问题。
That is the honest score: four of four witnessed, zero of four derived.
这就是诚实的比分：四问四有见证，四问零有推导。
A sharp no is closer to a law of nature than a blurry close enough.
清晰的“不行”比含混的“差不多”更接近自然律。

scenes.name: END
lines: Every reef is charted. The shore is still ahead.
每一座暗礁都已标注；海岸仍在前方。
